title: Underwriting Guide: Named Non-Owner Policy Acceptance Standards by Package
content:
Acceptance standards for the Named Non-Owner Policy differ by package in five respects (violation points at binding, violation points at renewal, a recent DUI/DWI conviction, years licensed and the FR-44 states); the remaining standards are the same on every package.

### Standards that differ by package

| Package | Maximum violation points at binding or on a mid-term package change | Maximum violation points when a renewal is offered | DUI/DWI conviction within 60 months acceptable | Minimum years licensed | States in which the package may back an FR-44 Operator certificate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | 24 | 30 | yes | 0 | none |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits with UM | 24 | 30 | yes | 0 | none |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50 | 16 | 20 | yes | 0 | none |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | 12 | 16 | yes | 1 | VA |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 | 12 | 16 | yes | 1 | FL, VA |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100 | 6 | 8 | no | 3 | FL, VA |

Points are the company's violation points of the named insured. A "maximum" is the highest count accepted: a count equal to the maximum is accepted, a count one above it is not.

### Standards common to every package

- **License status accepted at binding:** a valid license, or a license suspended pending proof of financial responsibility.
- **Owned vehicles:** owning, leasing or co-owning any registered vehicle makes the named insured ineligible.
- **Regular use:** a household or employer vehicle available to the named insured on more than 2 days in a calendar week counts as regular use and makes the named insured ineligible.
- **Household vehicle exception:** a household-owned vehicle does not bar eligibility when the named insured is a named excluded driver on the policy insuring that vehicle.
- **Non-Owner Statement:** the Non-Owner Statement (no owned vehicle, no regular use), signed by the named insured, is required at binding and at every renewal.
- **Age of the Non-Owner Statement:** at most 30 calendar days between the signing of the Non-Owner Statement and the effective date of the term it supports.
- **SR-22:** every package may back an SR-22 Operator certificate.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Situation | Package | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 12 violation points at binding | Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | accepted (equal to the maximum of 12) |
| 13 violation points at binding | Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | not accepted (above 12) |
| DUI conviction 40 months ago | Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100 | not acceptable on this package |
| Employer van available 2 days every week | any package | not regular use (not more than 2 days) |
| Employer van available 3 days every week | any package | regular use; ineligible |
| FR-44 Operator certificate, residence state FL | Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | the package may not back it (FL is not among its FR-44 states) |
